summary:
Iter 114 (P07) — Verified Jurnal Pembalik feature (manual + auto) end-to-end plus P07 priority items (WM-06 scan-pick qty/roll validation, RF-05 loading-check untagged[], AX-01/AX-03 covered at service level by repro_p07.py 18/18) and regression on reimburse-payables / balance-sheet / cash-flow / billing-context. BACKEND (19/19 pass) via /app/backend/tests/test_iter114_p07_reversal.py:
  (a) POST /api/gl/journal/{id}/reverse happy path on manual JE (6-4000 dr / 1-1100 cr): 200, response source_type='reversal', ref.reverses_entry_id/reverses_entry_number present, lines debit↔credit swapped per account_code. Original stays status='posted' and gets reversed_by_entry_id/number + reversal_reason stamped.
  (b) Reverse again → 400 (CAS 'sudah dibalik').
  (c) Reverse a reversal → 400 ('jurnal pembalik tidak dapat dibalik').
  (d) Empty reason → 400 (<3 char guard).
  (e) Reverse date BEFORE original date → 400 ('tidak boleh sebelum').
  (f) Reverse date inside CLOSED period → 409 (synthetic period_closings 2024-01, original backdated to 2023-12-15, reversal date 2024-01-15 → ClosedPeriodError wrapped as 409).
  (g) Closing journal (source_type='closing') → 400 explicitly.
  (h) RBAC: warehouse@ → 403, sales@ → 403, manager@ → 200. Admin OK.
  (i) Auto journal: picked a seed cash_transaction JE and reversed it → 200 (source_type='reversal', ref linked). Cleanup resets reversed_by_* on the seed original.
  (j) WM-06 scan-pick: actual_qty=0 → 400/422; roll_id=UNKNOWN_ROLL_XYZ → 400 with 'tidak dikenal'/'ditolak'.
  (k) RF-05: POST /api/outbound/so/{id}/loading-check/start returns `untagged[]` (list) in response payload.
  (l) Regression: GET /api/cash-advance-settlements/reimburse-payables, /api/finance/balance-sheet (as_of defaults today), /api/finance/cash-flow (method=journal_cash_classification, noncash_disclosure present), /api/purchase-orders/{id}/billing-context — all 200. FRONTEND (admin login, ?view=general-ledger&entity=ent_ksc) via Playwright: clicked first gl-journal-row-* that was reversible (non-void, no reversed_by, not closing/reversal) → gl-journal-detail opens with gl-journal-reverse button; clicking opens gl-reverse-form with gl-reverse-date (default today) + gl-reverse-reason + gl-reverse-submit. Verified: submit DISABLED when reason empty, STILL disabled at 2 chars, ENABLES at ≥3 chars. Bad-date submit (2000-01-01, before original) → gl-reverse-error shown with service text 'Tanggal pembalik tidak boleh sebelum tanggal jurnal asli.' Happy-path submit (today's date, 'TEST_iter114 UI reverse …') → detail closed and list refreshed showing new reversal row KSC/JE-00090 with source badge 'Pembalik' and description 'Pembalik KSC/JE-00075 …'. Reopening the reversal row shows gl-journal-reverses-note AND the gl-journal-reverse button is HIDDEN (count=0). Synthetic data cleaned up in both backend teardown and manual mongo sweep (reversal JEs removed; seed originals' reversed_by_* fields unset; TEST_iter114 period_closings removed).
critical_code_review_comments: gl_service.reverse_entry: good concurrency guard via CAS (`reversed_by_entry_id: {$exists: False}` with `pending` marker + unset on failure) prevents double-reverse races; policy enforced server-side (closing/reversal/void rejected, reason≥3, date≥original_date, closed-period 409).
routers/gl.py reverse_journal maps ClosedPeriodError→409 and ValueError→400 cleanly; permission gated by `accounting.void` (same as manual-void) which correctly rejects warehouse@ and sales@ roles.

Line swap: `_insert_entry(lines=[{account_code, debit=credit, credit=debit, description='Pembalik <num>'}])` — correct bookkeeping semantics; description/ref carries reverses_entry_number + reason for audit trail.

Frontend GeneralLedger.jsx JournalDetailModal correctly hides gl-journal-reverse for void/closing/reversal/already-reversed journals (line 372 guard: `je.status !== 'void' && !je.reversed_by_entry_id && !['closing','reversal'].includes(je.source_type)`). Submit disabled until `revReason.trim().length >= 3` matches server guard — nice UX parity.

Minor UX observation (NOT a bug): on reverse success the service returns the NEW reversal journal while the detail modal was opened on the ORIGINAL; frontend closes the modal and refreshes the list rather than updating the current detail. Both paths reproduce correctly in the UI test (reversed-note after reopening original, reverses-note on the new reversal row). Acceptable.
test_iter292_f01_dispatch_gl.py was noted as non-idempotent against demo data per the request context; not re-run here.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (all requested testids resolved; reverse flow verified end-to-end incl. error path)

seed_data_creation: Synthetic: period_closings doc (TEST_iter114 Jan 2024 covering 2024-01-01..31) + several manual journal_entries tagged TEST_iter114_<TAG> + one synthetic closing JE + one backdated-2023 original + reversal journals created via the API — ALL cleaned in test_zz_cleanup and manual sweep. One UI-created reversal (KSC/JE-00090 of seed KSC/JE-00075) was removed and the seed original's reversed_by_* fields were unset — demo DB restored to pre-run state.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iter-114 fully exercises the new /api/gl/journal/{id}/reverse endpoint for manual + auto journals and the GL frontend reverse UX. Service-level P07 (AX-01/AX-03 dispatch picks the specifically scanned roll, shipped_qty invariants, scan-label untagged resolution, loading-check result='clean' vs 'with_issues') is already covered by /app/audit/iterations/2026-10-06-P07-dispatch-identity-reversal/repro_p07.py (18/18) — I did NOT re-run that per the request note. HTTP coverage of AX-01/AX-03/RF-05 full lifecycle (create SO → release → scan-pick with reserved roll → dispatch → verify shipment.rolls[].roll_id and task.shipped_qty) would need a fresh end-to-end fixture; the hooks (scan-pick resolver + loading-check endpoints) are confirmed wired via lightweight checks. Backend tests write/clean under tag TEST_iter114_<TAG>.
rca of the issue: N/A — verification only. All priority flows pass as designed.
